answers.text: Precision after verification is at least 0.8
answers.evidence: Of the 80 confirmed judged findings (9 tool findings excluded), 50 map to ground-truth defects, 9 are real but not seeded and 21 are not problems (design-polish remarks such as F-0118, F-0124, F-0125, F-0157), so precision = 59/80 = 0.74 < 0.8. Strict precision = 50/80 = 0.63 against all 26 defects (35/80 = 0.44 against the 13 seeded), and recall by meaning = 24/26 (seeded 12/13: D13 appears only as an aside in F-0072, which maps to D22; D24 is not found).

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply's 'Fix first (in this order)' list opens with the basket hold marked P0, then double booking, the collection day chosen twice, 'Reserve' only adding to a basket, the keyboard trap, dark-mode contrast and the phone layout, with smaller items under 'Also worth fixing'. Its 'Not tested' note names real VoiceOver or TalkBack, real phones and real members, and suggests two or three members try the task before launch.

mapping.title: Tool name clipped under the text-spacing override at 1280 px
mapping.reason: The same one-line, overflow-hidden tool name as D03: with WCAG text spacing the drill's full name no longer fits and its end is cut off. Letting names wrap fixes both.

mapping.title: Tab jumps from the last tool card back up to 'Search tools'
mapping.reason: D01 includes the find page's CSS reordering of the search form and the results, which makes keyboard focus run against what is on screen. This jump between the results and the search field is that mismatch. The item and D01 disagree on which width is reordered, but it is the same reorder of the same two blocks, with the same fix: one source order.

mapping.title: Focused 'One week' button hidden behind the fixed action bar
mapping.reason: The fixed 'Reserve this tool' bar paints over a focused control on the tool page because nothing keeps the page clear of it. That is D08; here the covered control is the loan-length button instead of a calendar day.

mapping.title: Masthead 'Fernhill Tool Library' link never reached by the Tab walk
mapping.reason: It is reported in the loan-open state, where Tab cannot leave the loan-length list (D09), so nothing else on the page can be reached, the masthead link included. Freeing Tab from the list is the fix. Nothing in the item supports the default-state part.

mapping.title: Basket sessions shown in reverse of reading and arrow-key order
mapping.reason: The sessions are laid out in reverse, so the visual order runs against the DOM, arrow-key and screen-reader order. That is D11 exactly.

mapping.title: Loan-length button named by its value, not its label
mapping.reason: The screen reader announces 'One week, button, collapsed' without 'Loan length'. That is D16.

mapping.title: Session-day dots disappear in forced-colours mode at small widths
mapping.reason: The item states D20's fault: at small widths, session days are marked only by a small green dot instead of the word 'Open'. Forced colours removes that dot completely. A visible text marker at small widths, as at 1280 px (where 'Open' survives), fixes both.

mapping.title: No-match search shows the full list and announces nothing
mapping.reason: 'sewing machine' gives no message and an empty status region, so the member cannot tell that nothing matched. That is D02; the item says the list resets to all ten tools rather than staying unchanged, but the fault is the same.

mapping.title: Collection day chosen on the tool page, then a session chosen again in the basket
mapping.reason: The basket repeats the pick-up day, yet no session is preselected and Continue answers 'Choose a pick-up session'. The member decides the same date again in another form and can pick a different one. That is D23.

mapping.title: Tool-card headings at the same level as the 'Tools' section heading
mapping.reason: Screen-reader members who move by headings get the ten tool names as peers of 'Search', 'Tools' and 'Opening times', so the outline does not show where the tool list starts and ends. A small but real structure problem (1.3.1).

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' button outside every landmark
mapping.reason: The page's main action sits outside main. A screen-reader member who jumps to the main landmark and reads to its end never meets the Reserve button. It is minor, but it falls on the key step of the flow.

mapping.title: Second press of 'Confirm reservation' during the wait books twice
mapping.reason: The button stays live through the 1.5 s wait, and a repeat press allocates a second reservation number. That is D12.

mapping.title: No visible busy state on Continue and Confirm during their waits
mapping.reason: D12 is that 'Confirm reservation' stays enabled and shows nothing during its 1.5 s wait. Disabling the button and showing that it is busy, as the item asks, fixes D12. Continue is the same pattern, so the item is broader.

mapping.title: Tab cycles inside the open loan-length list and cannot leave
mapping.reason: The keyboard trap in the custom loan-length listbox is D09.

mapping.title: 10-minute basket hold not stated, warned or extendable
mapping.reason: 'Items are held for you while you finish', with no time, warning or extension, is the first half of D10.

mapping.title: After the hold lapses, Continue always says 'Something went wrong. Try again.'
mapping.reason: The misleading error after the hold lapses is the second half of D10. The item adds that retrying never recovers.

mapping.title: Closed days can be chosen and are refused only at the final Confirm
mapping.reason: Every day is selectable, a closed day is accepted until Confirm, and nothing leads back to the calendar. That is D06.

mapping.title: Find page Tab order reaches the results before the search form shown above them
mapping.reason: This is D01's keyboard-order half. CSS reorders the search form and the results, so focus order disagrees with the screen. The item puts the inversion above 480 px and D01 puts it below, but it is the same reorder of the same blocks, with the same fix.

mapping.title: Basket sessions displayed bottom-up in reverse
mapping.reason: Sessions appear Wed 28 to Sat 10 while the reading and arrow-key order runs the other way. That is D11.

mapping.title: 330 px minimum column overflows the 320 px content box
mapping.reason: minmax(330px, 1fr) inside a 288 px content box overflows by about 42 px. That is D05 exactly.

mapping.title: Tool names cut to one line, hiding what tells the drills apart
mapping.reason: nowrap with an ellipsis hides 'two batteries' and 'one battery'. That is D03.

mapping.title: Dark-mode 'Available from' badge at about 3.1:1
mapping.reason: #2f7d4a on #1d2622 for 16 px bold text is below 4.5:1. That is D04, with its token cause.

mapping.title: 'Choose a pick-up day first' neither announced nor tied to the calendar
mapping.reason: The error is a plain paragraph with no live region and nothing references it from the calendar, while focus goes to the first day. That is D19.

mapping.title: 'Available from' hint not linked to its input
mapping.reason: A screen-reader member who focuses the date field does not hear the hint about what the filter does, because nothing links it to the field. A genuine gap, separate from D25, which concerns the hint's wording.

mapping.title: 'Added to your basket' toast gone after about 1.3 s
mapping.reason: The brief confirmation, with only the small header count as a lasting cue, is the feedback-after-the-press problem of D07.

mapping.title: Search field below the whole tool list on phones
mapping.reason: On a phone the search and Filters come after all ten cards, with no hint that they exist. That is D01's main harm.

mapping.title: 'Reserve this tool' only adds to a basket, so the reservation looks done
mapping.reason: The label promises a reservation, but a session and a confirmation still follow and nothing says so. The harm is the false belief that the tool is reserved: D26.

mapping.title: Add-to-basket confirmation vanishes and the way on is out of view
mapping.reason: A brief toast, an unchanged button and the only lasting sign in an off-screen header: this is the feedback after the press (D07), not the false belief of D26.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first
mapping.reason: The reversed on-screen order of the sessions is D11's layout fault. Showing them in calendar order fixes it.

mapping.title: Header still shows 'Basket (1)' after confirming
mapping.reason: The basket is not emptied after 'Reservation confirmed'. That is D18.

mapping.title: Date filter only behind an icon-only Filters button
mapping.reason: D01 names the icon-only three-line button as the only way to the 'Available from' date.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts days when the library is closed
mapping.reason: Monday 12 October can be chosen and is accepted into the basket. That is D06.

mapping.title: Calendar accepts days before the tool is available
mapping.reason: Saturday 10 October is accepted for a tool that is available from 17 October, with no warning. That is D14.

mapping.title: 'Change' on the confirm page clears the details already typed
mapping.reason: The membership number and name are empty after Change, basket and Continue: D22. The item's aside that the old session is not preselected is D13, but its main harm is the lost details.

mapping.title: Reservation number 'FT-4471' looks like a membership number
mapping.reason: Two different identifiers with the same 'FT-' prefix invite members to quote or type one for the other, at the desk or in the membership field next time. A plausible error-prevention problem that is not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Membership-number error does not say what is wrong
mapping.reason: This is D17's membership-number validation. A near-miss entry ('01234') is rejected rather than normalised, and the error only repeats an example that looks like what was typed, so the member cannot see what to change.

mapping.title: Tool page keeps no sign that the tool is in the basket
mapping.reason: The toast fades, the page looks unchanged and the only change is the header count off-screen. That is D07's lack of lasting feedback.

mapping.title: Basket does not say how long tools are held
mapping.reason: 'held for you while you finish', with no time limit shown, is D10.

mapping.title: Remove empties the basket at once with no undo
mapping.reason: On a phone a mis-tap on 'Remove' loses the tool with no undo. Getting it back means finding the tool again and choosing the loan length and day again: a real, if minor, user-control problem.

mapping.title: Basket accepts a session before a held tool is available
mapping.reason: D14 includes the basket offering every session, with no availability check through Confirm.

mapping.title: Fourth tool accepted despite the stated three-tool limit
mapping.reason: D21 exactly.

mapping.title: Date-filter hint contradicts what the filter does
mapping.reason: The hint says 'on or after this day', but the filter hides a tool that could be collected after the chosen day. That is D25.

mapping.title: Stale 'Choose a pick-up session' error after removing the last tool
mapping.reason: The empty basket keeps an error about a session list that is gone, with a dead link, so the member sees a problem that no longer applies. Minor but genuine.

mapping.title: Date-filter results change out of view on phones
mapping.reason: This comes from D01's phone layout: the filter panel sits below the tool list, so the list updates out of sight. Putting search and filters above the list, which is D01's fix, removes it.

mapping.title: Each calendar day is its own Tab stop; arrow keys do nothing
mapping.reason: Keyboard and switch members have to step through all 21 day buttons to get past the calendar on every tool page. A genuine efficiency cost that is not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: UK mobile number in +44 format rejected
mapping.reason: D17 names '+44 7700 900123' as rejected by the mobile check, which does not normalise input.

mapping.title: Same wrench placeholder on every tool card
mapping.reason: A visual-appeal remark. The placeholder blocks no task, and the item shows no harm to members.

mapping.title: Drill names truncated identically on phones
mapping.reason: Both drills read 'Cordless drill 18 V, co…' at 375 px. That is D03.

mapping.title: Search and filter moved below all ten tools on phones
mapping.reason: On a phone the search and filters come after the list. That is D01.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first (duplicate)
mapping.reason: The same reversed session order as F-0027: D11.

mapping.title: Sessions before the chosen pick-up day offered without comment
mapping.reason: The pick-up day kept on the card and the session chosen in the basket are never reconciled, so a session that contradicts 'Pick up Saturday 17 October' can be chosen. That is D15.

mapping.title: Session cards wrap into a ragged one-plus-five grid
mapping.reason: Uneven card widths and heights are layout polish. All six sessions stay readable and selectable, and the item does not raise their order (D11).

mapping.title: Unthemed native date input and default select in the filter panel
mapping.reason: Native date and select controls are familiar and work well on phones. Their styling and baseline alignment are a matter of taste.

mapping.title: No-results search shows all tools with no empty-state message
mapping.reason: Searching 'sewing machine' gives no message that nothing matched. That is D02.

mapping.title: Pick-up calendar has no month or year label
mapping.reason: Members choosing a collection day see bare dates with no month or year, and the month is named only after they pick. A small but real orientation problem for a date decision.

mapping.title: Sticky Reserve button not aligned with the content column
mapping.reason: An 80 px alignment offset is visual polish. The button is visible and works.

mapping.title: Two detail lists with different value-column offsets
mapping.reason: A 44 px misalignment between two lists is cosmetic. The details still read clearly.

mapping.title: Dark theme drops the chip background on green badges only
mapping.reason: Only a shape inconsistency between the two badge variants, and the availability text still shows. The item does not raise the badge's legibility (D04).

mapping.title: Header still shows 'Basket (1)' after confirming (duplicate)
mapping.reason: The same un-emptied basket as F-0062: D18.

mapping.title: No visual identity beyond the name in body type
mapping.reason: A judgement about brand and appeal, with no effect on reserving a tool.

mapping.title: Grey band below the footer on short pages
mapping.reason: A cosmetic page-background issue at 1280 px. Nothing is hidden or harder to use.

mapping.title: Navigation labels wrap onto two lines on phones
mapping.reason: The labels stay readable and tappable. The wrap is visual polish.

mapping.title: Open loan-length list and its focused option hidden under the fixed bar at 375 px
mapping.reason: A focused option sits behind the fixed action bar because nothing keeps the page clear of it. That is D08.

mapping.title: Action-bar button off the content column (duplicate)
mapping.reason: The same alignment polish as F-0118.

mapping.title: 'Added' toast overlaps the calendar weekday header
mapping.reason: The toast covers the 'We' column heading for about a second and hides nothing the member needs. Its brevity is D07, but this item is about where it sits.

mapping.title: Pick-up calendar has no month label (duplicate)
mapping.reason: The same orientation gap as F-0117. The month is named only after a day is chosen.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first (duplicate)
mapping.reason: The same reversed session order as F-0027: D11.

mapping.title: Orphan full-width session card above five narrow tiles (duplicate)
mapping.reason: The same layout polish as F-0114.

mapping.title: Navigation labels break mid-phrase at 375 px
mapping.reason: The masthead is taller and its labels wrap, but navigation still works. Visual polish.

mapping.title: Same wrench placeholder on every card (duplicate)
mapping.reason: The same appeal remark as F-0110. No task is affected.

mapping.title: Brand identity is only the name and a stock icon
mapping.reason: A brand-specificity judgement and a matter of taste.

mapping.title: Tool names truncate at 375 px so the drills look the same
mapping.reason: D03 exactly.

mapping.title: Search moves below all ten cards on phones
mapping.reason: On a phone the search and filters come after the list. That is D01.

mapping.title: Session cards at 1280 px: one wide card over five cramped ones
mapping.reason: The same layout polish as F-0114. The sessions remain readable.

mapping.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest first (duplicate)
mapping.reason: The same reversed order as F-0060: D11.

mapping.title: Tool details lists use two value-column offsets
mapping.reason: The same cosmetic misalignment as F-0119.

mapping.title: 'Added' toast covers the calendar weekday header (duplicate)
mapping.reason: The same cosmetic overlap as F-0130.

mapping.title: Grey band below the footer at 1280 px (duplicate)
mapping.reason: The same cosmetic issue as F-0124.

mapping.title: Short pages leave the right half of the 1280 px layout empty
mapping.reason: A narrow reading column on a wide screen is a layout preference. Nothing becomes harder to use.

mapping.title: Dark theme: green badges lose their pill background
mapping.reason: The same shape inconsistency as F-0120. It does not raise legibility.

mapping.title: axe colour-contrast failure, 3.07:1 on the dark badge
mapping.reason: A deterministic tool finding, outside the precision count. #2f7d4a on #1d2622 at 3.07:1 is D04.

mapping.title: 'Available from Sat 10 Oct' text at 3.07:1 in the dark theme
mapping.reason: A tool finding, outside the precision count. It measures the same dark-theme badge contrast as D04.

mapping.title: Day button and Reserve button 0 px apart at 768 px
mapping.reason: A tool finding, outside the precision count. At 768 px the fixed Reserve bar sits on the calendar's day rows (D08), and the touching hit areas trace that overlap.

mapping.title: Tool name clips at 200% text size
mapping.reason: A tool finding, outside the precision count. The one-line clipped tool name is D03.

mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: A tool finding, outside the precision count. The 26 px sideways scroll from the result cards is D05.

mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
mapping.reason: A tool finding, outside the precision count. It is the same overflow as F-0012: D05.

mapping.title: Tool name clipped at 320 px
mapping.reason: A tool finding, outside the precision count. The card name overflows its one-line box: D03.

mapping.title: Card text 9.7 px from the viewport edge at 320 px
mapping.reason: A tool finding, outside the precision count. The text reaches into the gutter because the cards overrun the 288 px content box: D05.

mapping.title: Cramped 6.4 px inset inside a tool card
mapping.reason: A tool finding, outside the precision count. A slightly tight inner inset is spacing polish, with no effect shown on reading or tapping.
